title: Initiative Gating Oscillator: cross-company alignment and release cadence
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a lightweight, repeatable gating mechanism that translates company-level OKR progress into concrete release gates and sprint priorities for cross-functional initiatives. This causes ad-hoc escalations, duplicated work across Product/Eng/Design, and last-minute scope shifts that erode predictability.

Goal: Define and ship an "Initiative Gating Oscillator" framework: a set of decision rules, signal thresholds, and lightweight artifacts that let PMs, Eng leads, and Design leads agree on when an initiative moves between planning, canary, ramp, and full-release lanes. The framework must be simple to apply (<15 minutes per initiative per week), integrate with existing roadmap and Linear workflows, and expose clear telemetry for OKR health.

Scope:
- Define gating states and the minimal acceptance criteria for each state (Planning, Ready for Dev, Canary, Ramp, Full Release).
- Create a concise checklist template and a Linear workflow that maps states to issue labels, required owners, and approval steps.
- Instrument a lightweight OKR signal bus: top-level metrics (OKR health %, critical path blockers, capacity delta) fed into a dashboard and used as inputs to gating decisions.
- Surface gating status in the company roadmap view and provide escalation paths for cross-team blockers.
- Pilot with two initiatives in Cycle 41 and iterate based on feedback.

Out of scope: Automated rollout tooling, infra-level autoscaling changes, or replacing detailed release runbooks. Those will be owned by respective teams after gating decisions are standardized.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A one-page gating cheat-sheet and checklist published to Confluence; 2) Linear labels and workflow rules created and tested on pilot initiatives; 3) Dashboard showing at-a-glance gate signals for pilot initiatives; 4) Two pilot initiatives complete gating flow with retrospective feedback collected; 5) Playbook with escalation paths and owner roles approved by Eng, Design, Security, and Legal where applicable.

next_steps: 1) Finalize checklist and thresholds with Eng reliability by 2025-02-24. 2) Add Linear automation rule to apply labels when checklist completed. 3) Run two-week pilot with selected initiatives starting 2025-02-26. 4) Collect pilot metrics and retro by 2025-03-12. 5) Iterate playbook and prepare company-wide roll announcement for 2025-03-20.
notes: Design asked that gating not introduce friction into PLG teams with many small experiments. Suggested allowlist of fast experiments that bypass full gating if below defined risk/impact thresholds. Will draft allowlist criteria during pilot.
